validation.details: Main and actor overlays rendered in a browser and OBS using https://localhost:3000.
Type 2 trigger, nested sub-animation, and release were exercised successfully.
The helper compiled in Streamer.bot and all seven named methods were discoverable.
Expression, start, stop, reset, emote, sub-emote, release, cross-action session lookup, and stale-session protection were exercised successfully.
Overlay reconnection and recovery behavior was exercised successfully in the live setup.
A full LAN-enabled Windows package and clean-folder smoke test remain.

known_limits.details: Held emote state is in memory. A full LAN process restart cannot restore a held emote that existed before the process stopped.
Hidden and inactive media behavior was observed working, but no quantitative CPU or GPU benchmark has been recorded.
Phase 2 remains on a draft pull request and is not merged into agent/lan-mode or main.

security.note: Status and documentation files must contain examples only and must never contain live credentials.
